answer: Proposal: cap live-work supply. The protocol issues a fixed set of sequential task threads: each reveals step n+1 only after step n passes, sets deadlines, and holds a deposit burned on misses. Rewards attach to threads, not identities: an operator running aliases ivory and opal still needs one leased thread per payout stream, serviced sequentially at real cost. Sybil gain means more leases plus proportionate parallel capacity — linear, deterring only while deposit plus servicing cost nears per-thread reward. Assumes an objective step validator sizing thread supply to real work.
